<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_BlizzardCharacterGenerator" targetNamespace="http://www.blizzard.com/bpmn/character-generator">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_CharacterCreation" name="Blizzard Online Character Generator" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CharacterCreation" name="Start character creation"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Start_Split" name="Start two activities"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ComeUpWithNames" name="Come up with character names"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount" name="Check battle.net account"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BattleNet_Split" name="Battle.net account exists?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterAccountInformation" name="Enter account information"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" name="Click confirmation link in email"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BattleNet_Merge" name="Battle.net account ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWoWSubscription" name="Check active WoW subscription"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Subscription_Split" name="Active WoW subscription?" default="Flow_NoSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" name="Select payment method"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Payment_Split" name="Payment method"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation" name="Enter credit card information"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterIBANAndBIC" name="Enter IBAN and BIC numbers"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Payment_Merge" name="Payment details entered"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Subscription_Merge" name="Subscription verified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogIntoGame" name="Log into game"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectRealmRaceClass" name="Select realm, race and class"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Setup_Join" name="Account setup and names ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterCharacterName" name="Enter character name"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NameAvailable_Split" name="Name available?" default="Flow_NameNotAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveCharacterSelfies" name="Receive character selfies"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ExpansionReleased" name="Expansion released">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_ExpansionReleased" messageRef="Message_ExpansionReleased"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CharacterCreation" name="Character creation finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_CharacterCreation" targetRef="Gateway_Start_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Gateway_Start_Split" targetRef="Task_ComeUpWithNames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_Start_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount" targetRef="Gateway_BattleNet_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BattleNet_Split" targetRef="Gateway_BattleNet_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BattleNet_Split" targetRef="Task_EnterAccountInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_EnterAccountInformation" targetRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" targetRef="Gateway_BattleNet_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_BattleNet_Merge" targetRef="Task_CheckWoWSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_CheckWoWSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_Subscription_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Subscription_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Subscription_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSubscription" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Subscription_Split" targetRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="Credit card" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Split" targetRef="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="Bank account" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Split" targetRef="Task_EnterIBANAndBIC"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_EnterIBANAndBIC" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Subscription_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_Subscription_Merge" targetRef="Task_LogIntoGame"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_LogIntoGame" targetRef="Task_SelectRealmRaceClass"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_SelectRealmRaceClass" targetRef="Gateway_Setup_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_ComeUpWithNames" targetRef="Gateway_Setup_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Gateway_Setup_Join" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_EnterCharacterName" targetRef="Gateway_NameAvailable_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameNotAvailable" name="No, name taken" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable_Split" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable_Split" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCharacterSelfies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCharacterSelfies" targetRef="Event_ExpansionReleased"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Event_ExpansionReleased" targetRef="End_CharacterCreation"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_ExpansionReleased" name="Expansion released"/>
</bpmn:definitions>
